name: WebGPU Three.js Skill
headline: WebGPU Three.js Skill - Develop WebGPU Apps
short_description: Develop WebGPU applications with Three.js. Ideal for operations teams building high-performance 3D web apps. Integrates with existing Three.js workflows, enabling advanced rendering capabilities.
author: dgreenheck

sections.overview:
This skill equips Claude with comprehensive knowledge for developing WebGPU-enabled Three.js applications using TSL (Three.js Shading Language). It covers setting up Three.js with WebGPU renderer, writing shaders, creating node-based materials, building GPU compute shaders, implementing post-processing effects, and integrating custom WGSL code. Developers can leverage this skill to build high-performance 3D web applications with advanced rendering capabilities. The skill is aligned with Three.js r183+ API changes and supports both Claude Code and Cursor environments.
Building high-performance 3D web applications with WebGPU rendering
Writing GPU compute shaders and node-based materials in TSL
Implementing post-processing effects in Three.js
Integrating custom WGSL code with Three.js workflows
